HediffDef.label: Processed pawn connoisseur
HediffDef.description: This pawn loves to consume the treats dispensed by predators, who have so skillfully churned their prey into thick batter and creamy milk.

HediffDef.label: Processed pawn taste
HediffDef.description: This pawn likes to consume the remains of prey who have been churned into tasty beverages.

HediffDef.label: Processed pawn ambivalence
HediffDef.description: This pawn doesn't care one way or the other about consuming the remains of prey who have been churned into edibles.

HediffDef.label: Processed pawn distaste
HediffDef.description: This pawn dislikes consuming the remains of prey who have been churned into edibles. It's a waste of good food.

HediffDef.label: Processed pawn disgust
HediffDef.description: This pawn hates consuming the remains of prey who have been churned into edibles. It's a profane alchemy that mustn't grace its tongue.
